scope: Independent Punhos audit vs corresponding approved Idle: WalkS4, Dodge24, Giro24, Parry source9

methods.projectionLimit: Deep flexion, kick extension and foreshortening change silhouette/projected lengths; hidden bone lengths cannot be proved from these sprites.
methods.automatedColorBandMeasurementsRejected: Hair/coat/metal-shadow overlap made a brown-pixel width heuristic unreliable; no numerical hair-growth claim or pass/fail uses that heuristic.

findings.description: Giro N chamber/recovery has a rounder layered nape/dome compared with the pointed/tousled Idle N outline. Difference is visible in source and planned Unity scale; it is not a leg-length diagnosis.
findings.action: Targeted whole-figure identity review for these two N figures before any redraw; preserve all other correct figures. PPU cannot repair haircut.
findings.limits: Pose/turning can change overlap of locks; no calibrated scalp/hidden-neck measurement. Do not infer exact percentage of hair growth.

findings.description: Rear Dodge anticipation/recovery reads slightly broader/rounder in head/hair than corresponding rear idles. Low phase intentionally inclines torso/head, so it was excluded from like-pose warning.
findings.action: Recheck whole rear standing-like poses with the new approved Fists identity authority; do not compensate anatomy through PPU or regenerate the entire weapon.
findings.limits: Descriptor PPU153.0303 is planned; rear Dodge .png.meta was absent at audit. Width is qualitative, not a measured growth claim.

findings.description: No actual .png.meta found for rear/right Dodge at this audit; world-scale panels use descriptor PPU only.
findings.action: Coordinator import then verify actual spritePixelsToUnits, foot support and playback. Auditor did not run Unity.

findings.description: Parry source exists but producer confirms no descriptor/PPU/anchors/staging. Native anatomical look can be screened; real Unity scale cannot be audited yet.
findings.action: Keep candidate. Prepare source-preserving metadata/clip timing and review scale after preparation; do not infer approval from user praise of FistsWalk.

parryCandidate.visualConclusion: No obvious long thigh/shin or infant face isolated in source. Head/body/gear remain consistent with front idle family; no import/animation approval inferred.

conclusion: No clear stretched-thigh/shin defect requiring a skeletal redraw isolated among52 prepared figures. Preserve WalkS4 and existing correct anatomy. Rear hair silhouette/volume warnings are localized and not a blanket rejection. Native candidate Parry is not imported/approved by this audit.
limits: Import/meta presence does not prove runtime playback; auditor ran no Unity.
Rear/right Dodge actual scale pending import.
Static visual judgment is not a human approval and does not extend user praise of FistsWalk to all candidates.
Helpers initially clipped preview rectangles; regenerated panels were used and preview clipping was not classified as asset damage.
